name: not_hasEigenvalue_zero_tfae
statement: Module.End K M) : List.TFAE [ ¬ Module.End.HasEigenvalue φ 0, ¬ IsRoot (minpoly K φ) 0, constantCoeff φ.charpoly ≠ 0, LinearMap.det φ ≠ 0, ker φ = ⊥, ∀ (m : M), φ m = 0 → m = 0 ]
